Question: Assalmo Alaikum I saw a dream that a big snake comes in my house garden then another snake comes and the second snake divides into three mongoose (neola) and those three mongoose eat the first snake. After one month of this dream God gifted me a third son, does it relates to this drem Regards! Answer ID: 10712 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 163/148=L/1429) It is satanic dream. Recite Ayatul Kursi and the four Quls (Surah Kafiroon, Surah Ikhlas, Surah Falaq and Surah Naas) before going to bed, blow on hand and wipe the hand over entire body. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
